    <item>
      <title>UK Approves Jackdaw Gas Field as Energy Crisis Deepens</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/UK-Approves-Jackdaw-Gas-Field-as-Energy-Crisis-Deepens.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45830</guid>
      <description>The UK government on Wednesday approved the long-delayed Jackdaw gas field in the first approval of a new North Sea project since the Iran war hiked energy prices. Jackdaw will start to supply gas to British homes and businesses from the end of this month, after the UK Energy Secretary agreed that the regulator can grant consent for gas to be produced at the field, Andy Burnham’s Labour government said in a statement. The Jackdaw project, led by Adura, the new company Shell and Equinor have created by merging their oil and gas assets in the…</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:30:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Tsvetana Paraskova</dc:creator>
    </item>
<item>
      <title>Goldman Sachs Warns of New Oil Price Shock as Tanker Rates Soar</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Goldman-Sachs-Warns-of-New-Oil-Price-Shock-as-Tanker-Rates-Soar.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45829</guid>
      <description>The average global freight rate to transport oil has surged to $20 per barrel from $3 per barrel last year as the Iran war and the Hormuz crisis have created a shipping crisis that’s unlikely to end soon, Goldman Sachs says. Oil shipping rates are set to remain elevated in the near term amid no end in sight to the Middle East crisis, with the massive surge in freight costs posing an upside risk to Goldman’s current baseline oil price forecast of $90 per barrel Brent crude at the end of this year, the bank’s analysts said in a…</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 04:30:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Tsvetana Paraskova</dc:creator>
    </item>
<item>
      <title>India’s Coal Crisis Deepens as Power Demand Surges</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Indias-Coal-Crisis-Deepens-as-Power-Demand-Surges.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45828</guid>
      <description>Indian power generators are bracing for a coal supply squeeze, with half of the country’s coal power plant fleet operating with critically low stocks, Reuters has reported, citing higher than usual demand for electricity because of warmer than usual weather for this time of year. As many as 96 coal power plants in the country only have stocks for three days of consumption, the publication wrote, citing data from India’s Central Electricity Authority. This is up from 60 power plants operating with critically low stocks as of mid-September.…</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 03:30:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Irina Slav</dc:creator>
    </item>
<item>
      <title>Trump Administration Pushes Refiners to Boost Diesel Output as Prices Soar</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Trump-Administration-Pushes-Refiners-to-Boost-Diesel-Output-as-Prices-Soar.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45827</guid>
      <description>The U.S. Department of Energy has called on refiners to ramp up their diesel fuel production further, Reuters has reported, citing two high-ranking officials from the department. There are talks ongoing with refiners both in the United States and abroad, the report said. This is the latest move on the part of the federal government to push diesel prices down from all-time highs, with the national average stuck above $6 per gallon. The report follows a decision by President Trump to waive sanctions on Russian exports in a bid to secure additional…</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 02:00:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Irina Slav</dc:creator>

<item>
      <title>Oil Prices Climb Above $110 as Middle East Supply Fears Persist</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Climb-Above-110-as-Middle-East-Supply-Fears-Persist.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45826</guid>
      <description>Crude oil prices ticked higher earlier today, extending gains from Tuesday as traders continued to worry about the stability of flows out of the Middle East. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $110.30 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $99.12 per barrel, both up by over 1% from Tuesday. The latest inventory report out of the U.S. contributed to the bullish sentiment with another sizable draw estimated for last week. The rally also comes despite a Wall Street Journal report from Tuesday that said oil flows out of the Middle…</description>
      <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 00:11:27 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Irina Slav</dc:creator>

<item>
      <title>How Bad Would It Get If China Blocks Rare Earths to America?</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/How-Bad-Would-It-Get-If-China-Blocks-Rare-Earths-to-America.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45828</guid>
      <description>Taiwan is the next pressure point that will test China's weaponization of rare earth metals. When Japan indicated it would not remain neutral in a Taiwan conflict, Beijing responded by sharply restricting exports of several heavy rare earth materials, including dysprosium and terbium. Japan was the test case. With U.S.-China tensions escalating, a confrontation could likely lead to an immediate blockade of Chinese rare earths to American markets, pressuring U.S. defense without firing a single shot. From a defense perspective, it would be disastrous…</description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 19:00:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Tom Kool</dc:creator>

<item>
      <title>Petrobras' Deepwater Push Sets Off a Race for Offshore Vessels</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Petrobras-Deepwater-Push-Sets-Off-a-Race-for-Offshore-Vessels.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45830</guid>
      <description>Recently, we reported that the Middle East conflict and subsequent closure of the Strait of Hormuz has triggered an unprecedented spike in freight and shipping rates, with Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC) spot rates now exceeding $1 million per day. The sharp spike is now reshaping oil flows and forcing producers to cut prices in a bid to help buyers offset extra transport costs. The situation is a little different in Brazil, where the offshore sector is facing a potential vessel shortage as demand outruns supply amid the offshore oil boom, positioning…</description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 18:30:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Alex Kimani</dc:creator>

<item>
      <title>Mexico Poised to Approve $12.5 Billion in Renewable Energy Projects</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Alternative-Energy/Solar-Energy/Mexico-Poised-to-Approve-125-Billion-in-Renewable-Energy-Projects.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45829</guid>
      <description>Mexico’s state power utility is today set to greenlight as many as 60 alternative energy projects, most of them solar, that should add 8.2 GW in new generation capacity to the country’s total, according to an unnamed source that spoke to Bloomberg. The total investment in these projects could reach $12.5 billion. The projects set to be approved by the Federal Electricity Commission today may end up being fewer than 60, another source told Bloomberg, also wishing to remain unnamed. However many do get approved, they will go towards reaching…</description>

<item>
      <title>Europe’s Power Demand Returns to Growth</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Energy/Natural-Gas/Europes-Power-Demand-Returns-to-Growth.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45827</guid>
      <description>Despite weakening industrial activity and high energy costs, European electricity demand is bucking years of flailing power consumption. Rising electrification rates and the data center boom are the key drivers of this new trend in Europe’s power demand, which is set to gather momentum in the coming years amid the EU’s energy transition and the global AI boom. Europe’s electricity demand growth is nowhere near the pace seen in the United States and China in recent years, but it’s a marked shift nevertheless, after years…</description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:00:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Tsvetana Paraskova</dc:creator>

<item>
      <title>Energy Costs Are Driving U.S. Inflation, and Wages Aren't Keeping Up</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/Energy-Costs-Are-Driving-US-Inflation-and-Wages-Arent-Keeping-Up.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45821</guid>
      <description>Inflation rates remain blistering high across the United States. The Bureau of Labor Statistics’s most recent Consumer Price Index, released last week, revealed numbers that were higher than most projections, indicating long-term pain for consumers and a nightmare election cycle for Donald Trump. And the reason for all of it is huge and persistent volatility in global oil and gas markets.  The October 14 Consumer Price Index showed that overall, prices for goods and services across the United States have risen 3.7 percent over the last…</description>

<item>
      <title>API: Crude, Product Inventories Continue to Draw</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/API-Crude-Products-Continu-eto-Draw.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45825</guid>
      <description>The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States fell by 4.93 million barrels in the week ending October 16. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories fell by a staggering 11.12 million barrels. Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost more than 56 million barrels over the last 27 weeks, but US crude inventories are still only 5 million barrels below where they were at the beginning of the year, according to API data, kept in check in part thanks to draws from the SPR. For the…</description>
      <pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:56:00 -0500</pubDate>
      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>
      <dc:creator>Julianne Geiger</dc:creator>

      <title>The Middle East's Next Energy Boom Has Nothing to Do With Oil</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-General/The-Middle-Easts-Next-Energy-Boom-Has-Nothing-to-Do-With-Oil.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45824</guid>
      <description>A new Middle East energy system came into view at the Energy Trading Week Middle East conference in Dubai last month. The region’s world’s-lowest costs for solar energy appeared with enormous potential to transform how countries consume and export energy in low-carbon products. “Renewable power is actually very competitive now, so the spotlight for this region when it comes to energy transition is around three low carbon products," said Saravanan Manivel, Director for Low Carbon Fuels at ENGIE Global Energy Management & Sales.…</description>

<item>
      <title>One Kurdish Peace Deal Could Ignite Another Middle Eastern Conflict</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Geopolitics/Middle-East/One-Kurdish-Peace-Deal-Could-Ignite-Another-Middle-Eastern-Conflict.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45826</guid>
      <description>In October 2025, the PKK (Partiya Karkerên Kurdistanê, Kurdistan Workers' Party) announced it was withdrawing its fighters from Türkiye to northern Iraq as part of a peace effort with Ankara after four decades of hostilities. The statement said all PKK forces in Türkiye were being pulled back to northern Iraq "to avoid clashes or provocations." This followed the group's May 2025 decision to dissolve and a July ceremony where fighters burned their weapons. In late 2025 the PKK also said it had pulled out of the Zap border…</description>

<item>
      <title>Norway's Gas Production Plunges 12.6% as Europe Heads into Winter</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Gas-Production-Plunges-126-as-Europe-Heads-into-Winter.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-news-45824</guid>
      <description>Norway’s oil and gas production declined sharply in September, with natural gas output falling 12.6% from August, according to preliminary figures released Tuesday by the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (NOD). Total petroleum production averaged approximately 3.77 million barrels of oil equivalent per day (boepd), down 10.4% month-on-month and 4% below the directorate’s forecast. The decline comes at a sensitive time for European energy markets, with the winter heating season approaching and Norway remaining the continent’s largest…</description>

      <lastmod>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 05:43:51 -0500</lastmod>

      <title>Geothermal Just Proved It Can Compete With Solar-Plus-Storage on Price</title>
      <link>https://oilprice.com/Alternative-Energy/Geothermal-Energy/Geothermal-Just-Proved-It-Can-Compete-With-Solar-Plus-Storage-on-Price.html</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">oilprice-article-45820</guid>
      <description>Geothermal has long been the clean, firm power source that was always a few breakthroughs away from being cheap enough to matter. Numbers buried in a Nevada utility filing suggest that day may have arrived. Joel Edwards, co-founder and CTO of geothermal developer Zanskar, put it bluntly earlier this month: "to all the geothermal believers out there, the flippening has come." In NV Energy's 2026 resource plan, three geothermal offers came in at $105 to $107 per megawatt-hour. That's below the roughly $114/MWh capacity-weighted average for the 11…</description>
